sources.title: Washington State blown out by Texas State, 42-14
sources.description: In their final road game of the season, the Washington State Cougars were dominated by the Texas State Bobcats, 42-14. WSU (2-9, 1-6 in Pac-12) got in front early with the games’ first points on a Daniel Blood touchdown reception, then proceeded to allow 42 unanswered to TSU (7-4, 5-2). The Cougars got out to […]
